P1.2.text: Leading VLGC Owner And Operator Dedicated To Shipping LPG To Fuel The World's Energy Transition

P1.3.text: Dorian LPG is a liquefied petroleum gas shipping company and a leading owner and operator of modern very large gas carriers (“VLGCs”).

P1.4.text: We are proud to present the 4th edition of our sustainability report, which highlights our ongoing efforts to improve our environmental, social, and governance performance and transparency.

P1.5.text: At Dorian LPG we are always looking ahead at the future of shipping and the energy industry as a whole. As a transportation service provider, we rely on our reputation, experience and performance as key pillars for our success. Protecting the environment, the safety of our crew and our customers cargo, guide our entire organization to continuously improve and strive for operational excellence.

P2.2.text: Liquefied petroleum gas ("LPG") is a fossil fuel made during natural gas processing and oil refining. Two thirds of the LPG people use is extracted directly from the earth. The rest of it is manufactured indirectly from crude oil refining. Chemically LPG is a mixture of two flammable but nontoxic gases called propane and butane.

P2.3.text: LPG is liquefied in a tank or bottle in order to have more and take up less space. If you could see inside an LPG tank or bottle, you'd see a liquid not a gas. That's because the propane and butane have been compressed so they take up almost 275 times less space than normal. By comparison, the air in a typical car tire is pressurized to roughly 2–3 times normal air pressure—so the gas in an LPG tank is squeezed about 100 times more. LPG takes up relatively little space compared to the actual amount of energy it contains.

P2.4.text: LPG is cleaner than coal and oil and an alternative to gasoline. It makes less air pollution (fewer soot particulates, nitrogen oxides, and sulfur) and produces fewer emissions of carbon dioxide (which cause global warming). LPG is also highly portable, making it a convenient source of energy usable in remote places where ordinary gas supplies are unavailable or have been interrupted.

P2.5.text: There are more than 1,000 applications of LPG. Hundreds of millions of people currently use LPG and depend on it for thousands of applications: in commercial business, industry, transportation, farming, power generation, cooking, heating and for recreational purposes. It is referred to as the world’s most multi-purpose energy.

P2.6.text: Several billion people around the world use LPG at home for applications such as cooking and heating.

P2.7.text: LPG is the preferred alternative automotive transportation fuel and is increasingly being used as a marine fuel.

P2.8.text: Millions of businesses rely on LPG. It is the ideal fuel choice for businesses that are not connected to an existing electrical grid.

P2.9.text: Farmers across the world rely on LPG to meet the challenge of staying competitive in the modern agricultural environment.

P2.10.text: Other industries such as aerosol, refrigeration, and chemical feedstock all look to LPG to provide sustainable fuel alternatives.

P1.1.text: Dry Bulk Shipping Company | Genco Shipping

P1.2.text: Genco Shipping & Trading is the is the largest U.S.-headquartered drybulk shipping company.

P1.4.text: We are the largest U.S.-headquartered drybulk shipping company. Through our in-house commercial operating platform, we provide a full-service logistics solution for the transportation of commodities worldwide using a diversified fleet of modern, fuel-efficient vessels.

P1.5.text: Our mission of building an organization that concentrates on achieving the highest level of integrity has translated into measurable results. We are headquartered in New York, file as a U.S. domestic public company and have been rated #1 amongst shipping companies in an industry wide corporate governance and ESG scorecard.

P1.6.text: Over the last several years, Genco has implemented a disciplined approach towards allocating capital maintaining among the lowest leverage positions in its drybulk peer group. Given the cyclicality of the business, this approach has been prudent in light of the unique events that have materialized in recent years.

P1.7.text: Genco's Global Presence in New York, Copenhagen, Singapore and Chennai

P1.8.text: Shipping is a fuel-efficient and cost-effective form of transportation crucial to global trade. Many of the raw materials that we carry are building blocks of economic activity and also play a key role in alleviating poverty while providing a source of income and job creation for many developing nations.

P1.9.text: As one of the largest drybulk shipping companies in the world, Genco recognizes the need to run a safe and responsible business built for the long-term. We regularly integrate Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) practices into our operational and strategic decision making. As such, we aim to meet and, if possible and appropriate for our business, exceed minimum compliance levels set forth in rules and regulations governing the maritime industry. Over the last several years, we have taken various steps to reduce our carbon footprint and improve the environment, which includes purchasing modern, fuel-efficient vessels while divesting of older less fuel-efficient tonnage, among other important investments made to our sizeable fleet. Download our ESG Sustainability Report for further detail regarding key initiatives executed by the Genco team.

P2.1.text: Dry Bulk Shipping Operator | Genco Shipping

P2.2.text: Genco Shipping & Trading Limited is a U.S.-based drybulk shipowner focused on the seaborne transportation of commodities globally.

P2.4.text: Genco Shipping & Trading Limited is a U.S.-based drybulk shipowner focused on the seaborne transportation of commodities globally. Headquartered in New York City, with offices in Singapore and Copenhagen, Genco Shipping runs a truly global 24-hour operation offering a full-service logistics platform to our customers around the world. Our wholly owned high quality, modern fleet of dry cargo vessels consists of the larger Newcastlemax and Capesize vessels, as well as the medium-sized Ultramax and Supramax vessels, enabling us to carry a wide range of cargoes, including iron ore, grain, steel products, bauxite, cement, nickel ore among other commodities, along worldwide shipping routes.

P2.5.text: Since our inception Genco has developed a leading reputation as an owner of high-quality, modern tonnage that meets strict operational, safety, and environmental standards. Our unrelenting focus on achieving the highest industry standards has enabled us to earn the trust of leading multinational charterers.

P2.6.text: Genco’s sizeable and leading drybulk platform, which consists of 44 vessels and a team of experienced and dedicated onshore and seaborne professionals, is instrumental in our ability to serve as an essential link in international trade. Consistent with our focus on meeting the exacting needs of customers, we draw upon our considerable internal commercial management to provide a full service logistics solution and through our joint venture, GS Shipmanagement Pte.
